entries.title: Supporting independent journalism in Ukraine

entries.title: An Alien Mind
entries.summary: Jakub Pachocki reflects on increasingly capable AI and the challenge of keeping it aligned. He calls for stronger safeguards and international coordination.

entries.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
entries.summary: Inside OpenAI, coding agents are reshaping AI research. Explore early data on agent usage, experiment velocity, task complexity, and research acceleration.

entries.summary: OpenAI introduces Daybreak for Frontline Defenders. A $1 billion commitment expands access to frontier cyber AI, training, and support for essential services.

entries.title: Legora reviewed 41 documents in minutes with GPT-6 Astra
entries.summary: Legora used GPT-6 Astra to review 41 documents in minutes, find all four planted errors, and improve performance by nearly 40% in this financial-review workflow.

entries.title: Playco cut manual fixes 50% prototyping games with GPT-6 Astra

entries.title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
entries.summary: Introducing GPT-6 Astra, our most intelligent and aligned model yet, with state-of-the-art capabilities across computer use, coding, cybersecurity, and science.

entries.title: Safety overview: GPT-6 Astra
entries.summary: GPT-6 Astra is our most capable broadly deployed model and our first to reach the Critical level of cybersecurity capability under our Preparedness Framework.

entries.title: ATV Big Air Tour turned 3 days of work into 3 hours with ChatGPT
entries.summary: ATV Big Air Tour uses ChatGPT Work to speed up marketing, merchandising, and more. It even turned merchandise photos into an inventory website in 15 minutes.

entries.summary: Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs use AI agents to improve onboarding, account management, and developer integrations. See what enterprise leaders can apply.
